title: RAKL pre-action fibre receipt v1
description: Proposal-only, framework-process telemetry binding the problem fibre, retrieval authorities, chosen operator and predeclared discriminator BEFORE a consequential action executes. Mints no proof, lesson, tool, gluing, theorem or review-independence authority. Carries no claim that the fibre search universe was complete: retrieval-universe coverage is a separate object (RAKL issue #119). The companion runtime is rakl.pre_action_receipt; chronology status is derived by comparing this receipt with the resulting TaskEpisode and is never declared inside the receipt.

operator_ids.description: Chosen action identity, frozen before execution.

selected_retrievals.description: Artifacts retrieved into the fibre. Authority is recorded per artifact; only CANONICAL may bear authority into the action. PENDING, NONCANONICAL and UNSPECIFIED artifacts may inform it and nothing more.

rejected_retrievals.description: Artifacts judged relevant and deliberately not used, with the reason. Recording rejections distinguishes 'considered and set aside' from 'never seen'; it does not make the search universe complete.

predeclared_discriminator.description: The falsifier/discriminator declared before execution. Inside the hashed content so that post-hoc substitution changes receipt_canonical_sha256.
